title: Behari Lal Engineering IPO Draws Strong Demand, Subscribed Over 2x on Opening Day
excerpt: The Punjab-based engineering castings maker's ₹302-crore mainboard IPO attracted robust retail interest on its first day of bidding, with grey market premium holding steady at 27% above the issue price.
body:
• Behari Lal Engineering's mainboard IPO was subscribed 2.21 times on its opening day, with retail investors leading at 2.74x and non-institutional investors at 2.14x.
  • The grey market premium stands at ₹78 per share, indicating a potential listing gain of 27.4% over the upper band price of ₹285.
  • The ₹302-crore IPO, priced at ₹271-285 per share, closes on August 14 with a tentative listing date of August 19 on the BSE and NSE.

Behari Lal Engineering Limited's initial public offering received a strong opening response, with overall subscription reaching 2.21 times on Day 1 of the three-day bidding period that opened on August 12. The mainboard IPO, valued at approximately ₹302 crore at the upper end of its price band, drew particular enthusiasm from retail investors.

Subscription Breakdown

Retail individual investors led the demand, subscribing 2.74 times their allotted portion. Non-institutional investors (NIIs), including high-net-worth individuals, subscribed 2.14 times their quota. Qualified institutional buyers (QIBs) were more measured at 0.98 times, with institutional demand expected to pick up on the final day of bidding.

The subscription pattern is consistent with mainboard IPOs that carry a healthy grey market premium. At last check, the GMP stood at ₹78 per share, implying a potential listing price of approximately ₹363 — a gain of 27.4% over the upper band price of ₹285.

Company Profile

Behari Lal Engineering manufactures engineering castings, alloy steel products, and metal rolls for the steel, power, and heavy engineering sectors. Established in Punjab in 1995 as Behari Lal Ispat Pvt Ltd, the company was converted into a public limited entity in 2024 and renamed to reflect its expanded product range.

The company operates two integrated manufacturing facilities in Mandi Gobindgarh, Punjab — one housing a steel melting shop and foundry, the other a rolling mill division. Both facilities have in-house design, testing, and R&D capabilities.

IPO Structure and Use of Proceeds

The offering comprises a fresh issue of equity shares worth up to ₹93 crore and an Offer for Sale (OFS) of up to 73.20 lakh equity shares by promoters Rajesh Garg, Lovlish Garg, promoter group member Yogita Garg, Dinesh Kumar Garg HUF, and investor selling shareholder SG Tech Engineering Private Limited.

Proceeds from the fresh issue will fund the purchase of new machinery and equipment to expand manufacturing capacity, related civil works at both Punjab facilities, installation of rooftop solar panels, and repayment of certain borrowings.

The price band is set at ₹271 to ₹285 per equity share with a face value of ₹10 each. The minimum lot size is 52 shares, requiring a retail investment of ₹14,820 at the upper band.

Key Dates

The IPO closes on August 14. Anchor investor allocation took place on August 11. The basis of allotment is tentatively scheduled for August 17, with refunds and demat credit on August 18. Shares are expected to list on both the BSE and NSE on August 19.

Emkay Global Financial Services and Systematix Corporate Services are the book-running lead managers. MUFG Intime India is the registrar to the issue.

Half the issue is reserved for QIBs, including 5% for mutual funds. Non-institutional investors get 15% and retail investors 35% of the total offering.
